statements.quote: Specifically, the Intelligent Infrastructure segment net revenue increased 34% primarily due to: (i) a 30% increase in revenues from existing customers within our cloud and data center infrastructure business and (ii) a 10% increase in revenues from existing customers within our capital equipment business.
statements.notes: Attributes segment revenue growth to cloud and data center infrastructure demand. The 30% and 34% figures are year-over-year growth rates, not a dollar amount or a share of total revenue, so it is recorded as qualitative. Cloud/data center is a proxy for AI demand; the sentence does not say AI.
